name: LDAP Single Sign-on
description: Sign users in against an LDAP directory such as Active Directory or FreeIPA. Directory users get a Matinee account on first sign-in, and an existing local account of the same name is linked to its directory identity.
author: Michael André Reber

config.label: Fill in the Active Directory example
config.description: Fills the fields below with values for a Windows domain. Replace the host, base DN and service account, then save.

config.label: Fill in the FreeIPA example
config.description: Fills the fields below with values for a FreeIPA or 389 Directory Server domain.

config.label: Name shown on the login page
Directory URL
config.description: ldaps://dc1.example.com:636 for LDAP over TLS, ldap://host:389 for a plain connection. Link-local and cloud metadata addresses are refused.

config.label: Accept self-signed certificates
config.description: Skips certificate verification on port 636 and for StartTLS. Only for a directory whose certificate is not signed by a CA this server trusts.

config.label: Upgrade a plain ldap:// connection with StartTLS
Service account DN
config.description: A read-only account used to look users up. Leave empty to bind as the signing-in user through the user DN template instead.

config.label: User base DN
config.description: Where the user search starts, for example DC=example,DC=com.

config.label: User filter
config.description: LDAP filter with {username} standing for the escaped login name, for example (&(objectClass=user)(sAMAccountName={username})).

config.label: User DN template
config.description: Only without a service account. The DN or principal to bind as, with {username} filled in, for example {username}@example.com or uid={username},cn=users,cn=accounts,dc=example,dc=com.

config.label: Stable id attribute
config.description: The attribute the Matinee account stays linked to across renames. objectGUID on Active Directory, ipaUniqueID on FreeIPA. The DN is used when the attribute is missing.

config.label: Administrator group DN
config.description: Members of this group become Matinee administrators and everyone else is demoted on sign-in. Leave empty to manage the admin flag in Matinee.

config.label: Group membership attribute
config.description: Default memberOf. Compared against the administrator group DN.

config.label: Test connection
config.description: Binds with the service account and counts the users the filter matches.
